JobInfo.Summary: Branch out your career with Banyule City Council
JobInfo.Description:
Branch out your career with Banyule City Council

Are you passionate about urban forestry and committed to maintaining a healthy, safe, and vibrant environment for the community? This is an exciting opportunity to join Banyule's Parks and Natural Environment team and make a tangible contribution to the care and management of our urban forest.

Working with a skilled and supportive team, you'll lead important arboricultural works that improve public safety, enhance neighbourhood amenity, and help maintain a healthy and resilient tree canopy for future generations.
